svg.text: A100 · token DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23) · inference · d 768, cond 384, pair 128, 16 heads × 48, transition n = 2, bf16
one step of a stack of blocks (A samples; each block's last residual pass fuses with the next block's AdaLN)
P1 · conditioning (once per step, every block)
ĉ = LN(cond) # statistics shared by every block's LN
G1 = ĉ @ W1'ᵀ + b1 # per block: scale, shift of the attention and the transition AdaLN
G2 = cond @ W2ᵀ + b2 # per block: the two output gates
P2 · pair bias (once per pair tensor)
bias = (Wf @ p̂ᵀ) · log2 e # every block, head-major
M1 · q | k | v | g projection
qkvg = xa @ Wqkvgᵀ + b # Wq, bq pre-scaled by sm_scale · log2 e
s = q kᵀ + bias # base 2, per sample and head
q ← sigmoid(g) · o # written over q
xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(G1s') + G1b' # the transition's AdaLN
xa = AdaLN(x) of the next block # or out = x, the last block
